description: The Oros basin study applies ResNetM to reservoir-network connectivity. Sensitivity analysis attributes the largest tested effects to network topology and runoff coefficient. This resource is provided by Cristian Epifanio Toledo; Nayra Rodrigues Alcantara. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists JPG, XLS formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Sensitivity indices are specific to the study perturbations and should not be treated as universal rankings. For simulation, it documents an application that can inform scenario design. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
